entities.summary: Christopher Dewayne Carson is an American former professional football player who was a running back for five seasons with the Seattle Seahawks of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football at Butler Community College before transferring to the Oklahoma State Cowboys program in 2016. A neck injury during the 2021 NFL season prematurely ended his career.
